    • Method Detail

      • createUser

        public User createUser​(java.lang.String username,
                       java.lang.String passwordHash)
                throws java.sql.SQLException
        Stores an account using an already-hashed password; does not authenticate it.
        Parameters:
        username - nonblank username, trimmed before storage
        passwordHash - nonempty password hash, stored unchanged
        Returns:
        persisted user with a generated identifier and no password data
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if username is blank or hash is null or empty
        java.sql.SQLException - if storage fails, including duplicate usernames

      • authenticate

        public User authenticate​(java.lang.String username,
                         java.lang.String passwordHash)
                  throws java.sql.SQLException
        Matches an account against an already-hashed password without changing a session.
        Parameters:
        username - username, trimmed for lookup
        passwordHash - hash to compare, not a raw password
        Returns:
        matching user, or null for invalid input or no match

      • changePassword

        public boolean changePassword​(int userId,
                              java.lang.String currentHash,
                              java.lang.String newHash)
                       throws java.sql.SQLException
        Atomically replaces a hash only if the account still has the expected hash.
        Parameters:
        userId - positive identifier of the account to update
        currentHash - expected nonempty stored password hash
        newHash - nonempty replacement password hash
        Returns:
        true if one matching account was updated; false if the account is absent or its stored hash no longer matches
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is not positive or either hash is null or empty
        java.sql.SQLException - if database access fails
